methodologyNotes: The roster covers nine widely searched mid-to-full-tower desktop PC cases spanning 2020-2024: Lian Li O11 Dynamic EVO, Fractal Design North, Corsair 4000D Airflow, NZXT H7 Flow (2024), Lian Li Lancool 216, Hyte Y70, Montech AIR 903 MAX, Phanteks NV7, and Fractal Design Torrent. Specs were drawn from official manufacturer product pages (primary source), confirmed against major retail listings (Newegg, Amazon) and reputable reviews (Tom's Hardware, GamersNexus, TechPowerUp, KitGuru). Prices reflect US MSRP at launch or the lowest documented official retail price; dimensions are external in mm (D x W x H); radiator_support lists the maximum radiator size in mm by location; included_fans states count and size; boolean fields are true/false. All nine products independently re-verified against manufacturer spec pages on 2026-06-15. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
